title: Th17 Cell-Related Gene Biomarkers in Autoimmune Thyroiditis: Comprehensive Bioinformatics Analysis and In Vivo Validation.
snippet: The objective of this research was to comprehensively explore the molecular pathways through which Th17 cells contribute to autoimmune thyroiditis (AIT). This was achieved by pinpointing key gene biomarkers associated with Th17 cell activity and elucidating their regulatory functions in thyroid inflammation.
